Messages.Author: Matthew Green
Messages.Body:
From the WW site:

--

Tortured Confession
Combat (1)

Only useable when the opposing vampire goes into torpor; not useable by
a vampire going into torpor. Combat ends. You may look at the opposing
vampires’ controller’s hand.

-Flavour Text: Quote from Josef Stalin.

Chas Giovanni Tello
Vampire (4)

Independent : When Chas announces an action, any Methuselah can discard
a master card as an out-of-turn master to cause the action to fail. Chas
gets +1 strength when in combat with a titled vampire.

--

Good to see some flavour text, markedly better than blank space. Chas
seems to be OK. Quite useable. Malkavians might have some use for
Tortured Confession with Claws/Rots to check the prey's bleed-bouce
capabilities. Interesting.

matt.

Messages.Author: Alex
Messages.Body:
Regarding the new Giovanni, when another player plays an out of turn
master, does the Giovanni's action fail as if "blocked" or fail as in
"cancelled, may attempt a different action?"

Thanks in advance

Alex

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <3eac2586.01052...@posting.google.com>,

Alex <ahar...@yahoo.com> wrote:
>Regarding the new Giovanni, when another player plays an out of turn
>master, does the Giovanni's action fail as if "blocked" or fail as in
>"cancelled, may attempt a different action?"

Chas takes an action, tapping to do so.
Sinister Methuselah X plays Chas' Action Fails as an out-of-turn master.
As a result, Chas' action fails.

Nothing else happens. This is the sum total of what happens.

Among the many other things that do not happen is:

a) Chas is not untapped, and therefore may not take another action.
b) Chas' action is not considered blocked in any way.
c) Chas' action does not succeed in any way.

gomi
